claims.finding: VersaBank filed Form 425 business-combination communications on 2026-07-28, 2026-08-05 and 2026-08-25, each paired with a 6-K the same day or the day before, and distributed a notice of meeting and proxy materials to shareholders on 2026-08-24 - i.e. a securities-registered transaction requiring a shareholder vote is live across the entire run-in to this print.
claims.corpus_ref: filings.json, Form 425 entries dated 2026-08-25, 2026-08-05 and 2026-07-28 with 6-Ks alongside each; docs/f2233c222cdecfd599d1e0f50b9cac4e2c71cfed.txt entry dated 2026-08-24T23:24:29Z ('distributed a notice of meeting and proxy materials to shareholders')
claims.why_not_priced: No news search was run for this ticker (n_queries=0 in every admissible sweep) and the entire admissible social stream is three messages, one of which is a bare link - a shareholder writes on 2026-08-21 'I am pretty excited for earnings but I think I am the only one'. A Form 425 is the least-read filing type there is, and three of them in a month at a 93,825-share-a-day bank is an unaggregated fact. Its consequence is directional only weakly - deal progress is mildly positive - but it is strongly informative about magnitude: the quarter cannot move a stock whose price is set by exchange terms, which is why I am near the bottom of the distribution rather than at the median.
claims.independence: The company also filed 6-Ks on 2026-08-24, 08-25 (twice), 08-26 and 09-01 - an unusually dense filing cadence for a bank - which corroborates that something transactional rather than routine is in progress: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001690639&type=6-K
